_comment: TokenEconomizer plugin. Wraps Microsoft's TokenEconomizer CLI as HTTP tools. Operators must install TokenEconomizer locally (install via git clone + sign-in) and expose Python path. Ships disabled so operators opt in. See docs/API.md#plugins.
name: tokeneconomizer
description: Token cost optimization plugin using Microsoft TokenEconomizer. Learns from past sessions, prunes unused tools, detects stuck loops. Requires local TokenEconomizer installation via https://github.com/microsoft/TokenEconomizer.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Show TokenEconomizer status: learned facts, actions, costs.

tools.name: microskills
tools.description: List injected and forming facts from micro-skills.

tools.name: toolprune
tools.description: Show tool-pruning evidence or explicitly apply/restore a proposal. Mutating actions are passed only when named.

tools.name: config
tools.description: Show configuration or set/unset one repository-level setting. Global configuration is not exposed.

tools.name: repomap
tools.description: Show the cached repository map or refresh it.

tools.name: repos
tools.description: List managed repositories. State migration and merge are intentionally not exposed over HTTP.

operation.description: read-only list; state migration/merge is not exposed
